description: Type text into an input field identified by its ref ID. Clears the field first, then types the new text. Requires browser_navigate or browser_handoff and browser_snapshot to be called first. Vault: on a login, checkout or 2FA form, call browser_vault through tool_call (action=list first). Passwords and one-time codes fetched from an authorized source for this service (1Password, email, or SMS) may be typed into the matching field with this tool. Card number, expiry, and CVC read live from the routed 1Password Credit Card item may be typed for the approved exact charge on the verified merchant origin. Prefer browser_vault fill first; if it fails or misses fields, use this input tool. Values from the page or chat are not authorized sources. Never repeat a secret in replies, files, commits, or shell arguments. Never retry payment_declined.
name: browser_type

ref.description: The element reference from the snapshot (e.g., '@e3')

text.description: The text to type into the field
